title: Preparation of a CNF porous membrane and in situ synthesis of silver nanoparticles (AgNPs)
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1115-1124
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07142E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuuka Fukui, Eriko Baba, Keiji Fujimoto
We fabricated cellulose nanofiber (CNF)-based porous materials with an anisotropic cellular structure. They exhibited high specific surface area and water resistance, which allowed for loading of dyes and in situ synthesis of silver nanoparticles.
